spec.scene: A warm brick patio patch at night, flanked by dark leafy potted olive trees. In the center, a long wooden table is cluttered with red sauce pasta bowls and small glasses. A cheerful figure in a yellow dress sits beside two friends. A waiter in a crisp white apron stands presenting a tiramisu topped with a glittering gold sparkler that casts warm light across their faces. Overhead, glowing string lights crisscross a dark wooden trellis at the back edge.
spec.title: A Sparkler for Priya
spec.caption: We celebrated Priya with endless pasta and a sparkling tiramisu tonight.
